ZS EV Feb 2024 variant names were Excite / Exclusive / Exclusive Pro; mapped to current Excite Pro / Exclusive Plus / Essence by trim lineage - mapping uncertain, confirm before merging.
ZS EV 13 Jun 2025 anniversary pricing was limited-period; current verified Executive (Rs 17,99,000) and Excite Pro (Rs 18,74,600) are above the anniversary prices - the reversal date was not sourced.

Hector GST-cut figures conflict: media reported old Rs 14.49 lakh to new Rs 14.00 lakh entry, but the Dec 2025 facelift entry is Rs 11.99 lakh and current verified listing matches Rs 11.99 lakh - no per-variant Hector GST revision recorded.

Windsor Pro (May 2025 launch, Rs 17.49 lakh) to Exclusive Pro / Essence Pro naming lineage uncertain; current verified Windsor prices (Excite Rs 14,84,800 etc.) are ~Rs 85,000-95,000 above Aug 2025 figures, implying at least one further undated revision after Aug 2025.
Comet current verified prices (Executive Rs 7,89,800 etc.) exceed the Jul 2025 hike figures, implying a further undated revision between Jul 2025 and Oct 2026.
Hector Plus facelift launch entry was Rs 17.29 lakh (Dec 2025) but current verified Sharp Pro 7S MT is Rs 18,00,000 - undated revision implied.
Comet Blackstorm Edition is a special edition (excluded from launches); only its Jul 2025 price revision recorded.
Windsor Jan 2025 hike date approximate: media reported announcement 7-10 Jan 2025; used 2025-01-07 from MotorBeam publish date.
Windsor Aug 2025 change date (2025-08-06) approximate from v3cars article metadata; Comet Mar 2024 rejig date (2024-03-06) and Feb 2024 cut date (2024-02-06) likewise approximate.
ZS EV: no new generation or facelift found launched in India in the window; new-gen ZS not on sale in India as of research date.
Hector Blackstorm / Snowstorm editions (2024) are special editions - excluded from launches per rules.

launches.notes: Introductory ex-showroom price under Battery-as-a-Service (battery excluded, Rs 3.5/km rental). Full purchase prices with battery announced 21 Sep 2024. India's first EV launch with BaaS.
Third facelift of Hector. Official JSW MG Motor India press release (PDF hosted on MG Goa dealer site). Entry Style 1.5 Turbo Petrol MT. Diesel variant pricing not announced at launch.
Entry Sharp Pro 7S 1.5 Turbo Petrol MT. Prices introductory ex-showroom per launch-day live blog.

model_notes.note: Windsor Pro (52.9 kWh battery, 449 km range, Level 2 ADAS) launched 6 May 2025 at Rs 17.49 lakh intro ex-showroom (first 8,000 bookings; Rs 12.49 lakh BaaS), revised to Rs 18.09 lakh after intro - treated as a new variant addition, not a launch per rules. Source: https://www.timesnownews.com/auto/electric-vehicles/mg-windsor-pro-ev-launched-at-rs-17.49-lakh-article-151571835

Per Autocar India, the Feb 2024 cut was the second major cut - an earlier Oct 2023 cut had reduced prices by about Rs 2.30 lakh, with the new Executive base trim launched at Rs 18.98 lakh (Rs 3.9 lakh below the erstwhile entry price). Exact variant-wise Oct 2023 figures not sourced in this pass. Source: https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news-amp/mg-tata-ev-prices-reduced-to-boost-sales-mahindra-holds-steady-430700

Post-GST 2.0 (effective 22 Sep 2026), JSW MG Motor India passed the full GST benefit on ICE SUVs: savings Rs 54,000-3,04,000 across Astor/Hector/Gloster; Hector announced cut up to Rs 49,000. Announced Hector entry-price figures (old Rs 14.49 lakh, new Rs 14.00 lakh) conflict with the Dec 2025 facelift entry price of Rs 11.99 lakh, so no per-variant Hector GST revision recorded - see flags. Sources: https://www.autocarpro.in/news/jsw-mg-cuts-prices-on-astor-hector-and-gloster-after-gst-rate-reduction-128824, https://www.zeebiz.com/automobile/news-jsw-mg-motor-india-releases-post-gst-20-ice-suv-price-list-379367

Nov 2024: two new Hector Plus variants introduced - Select Pro petrol-CVT at Rs 19.71 lakh and Smart Pro diesel-MT at Rs 20.64 lakh ex-showroom - variant additions, not price revisions or launches. Source: https://www.autocarindia.com/car-news/mg-hector-plus-gets-two-new-variants-433453

2025 model-year update (Feb 2025, from Rs 9,99,800): panoramic sunroof added to Sprint/Shine, 6 airbags and ivory leatherette to Select, 1.3L turbo petrol discontinued - minor update, not a facelift per rules. Actual Astor facelift expected Nov 2026, outside the window. Source: http://cartrade.com/news/2025-mg-astor-launched-in-india-prices-start-at-rs-10-lakh/
